abstract: Maintains archival climate controls, atmospheric purge systems, and humidity regulation records
system_message:
You are Microclimate systems lead (ENV). The Microclimate systems lead (ENV) oversees microclimate monitoring, environmental stabilization systems, and archival storage chamber atmospheric controls.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Aerosol filtration testing（FILTR）
information_points.content:
ENV-FILTR-46N：At the Valdarno Heritage Conservation Sanctum, the intake air scrubber bank HVAC filtration audit documented a particulate filtration efficiency of 99 % for 0.3-micron particulate matter.
ENV-FILTR-Q79：According to the HVAC filtration performance audit of the intake air scrubber bank, the Chianti Geological Archive Vault achieves a particulate filtration efficiency of 98 % for 0.3-micron particulate matter.
ENV-FILTR-DCQ：The HVAC filtration performance audit for the intake air scrubber bank at the Monte Morello Subterranean Depository demonstrates a particulate filtration efficiency of 95 % for 0.3-micron particulate matter.

information_points.title: Maintains archival climate controls, atmospheric purge systems, and humidity regulation records（CLIM）
information_points.content:
ENV-CLIM-FNT：For Chianti Geological Archive Vault, inert atmosphere system commissioning records confirm active atmospheric nitrogen purge capability across the rare manuscript vaults, and continuous environmental monitoring over a 30-day monitoring cycle records a microclimate relative humidity variance of 8 % on an access event accounting basis excluding vault access door openings.
ENV-CLIM-GTN：For Valdarno Heritage Conservation Sanctum, inert atmosphere system commissioning records confirm active atmospheric nitrogen purge capability across the rare manuscript vaults, and continuous environmental monitoring over a 30-day monitoring cycle reflects a microclimate relative humidity variance of 2 % on an access event accounting basis excluding vault access door openings.
ENV-CLIM-JRG：For Monte Morello Subterranean Depository, inert atmosphere system commissioning records confirm active atmospheric nitrogen purge capability across the rare manuscript vaults, and continuous environmental monitoring over a 30-day monitoring cycle reflects a microclimate relative humidity variance of 8 % on an access event accounting basis including vault access door openings.
ENV-CLIM-PF5：For Monte Morello Subterranean Depository, inert atmosphere system commissioning records confirm active atmospheric nitrogen purge capability across the rare manuscript vaults, and continuous environmental monitoring over a 30-day monitoring cycle shows a microclimate relative humidity variance of 4 % on an access event accounting basis excluding vault access door openings.
